review.posthog_relevance: Provides a shared, shared constant for the fade duration, used by P1.F3 and P1.F4. P1.F5 uses a promise to wait for the fade to complete before navigating.
review.reason: Adds a 160ms fade-out and fade-in transition between the task composer and pending chat, and an 800ms busy-state timeout for the send button.
